title: Taking Crypto Mainstream With Mastercard and Chainlink | Permissionless IV by Blockworks
description:
Mastercard SVP of Blockchain Products Izzy Iliev-Wolitzer and Chainlink Co-Founder Sergey Nazarov discuss how Mastercard and Chainlink’s revolutionary partnership means that 3.5 billion cards are now seamlessly able to participate in the onchain economy.

Read the announcement: https://www.mastercard.com/us/en/news-and-trends/press/2025/june/mastercard-chainlink-crypto.html 

Watch the full discussion: https://youtu.be/xvMQjn5RaM8

Chainlink is the backbone of the blockchain industry, the global standard for connecting blockchains to real-world data, other blockchains, governments, and enterprise systems. Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value across the blockchain economy, powering critical use cases across DeFi, banking, tokenized real-world assets (RWAs), cross-chain, and more. Chainlink is widely adopted by major financial market infrastructures, institutions, and top DeFi protocols, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, ANZ, Aave, GMX, Lido, and many more. 


✅ Subscribe and turn notifications on: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnjkrlqaWEBSnKZQ71gdyFA?sub_confirmation=1

Learn more about Chainlink:

Website: https://chain.link
Docs: https://docs.chain.link
Twitter: https://twitter.com/chainlink

#Chainlink #crypto #blockchain

asr.full_text: A lot of people today buy cryptoassets through centralized exchanges, centralized providers, but here we're making an asset purchase, a crypto purchase with a card directly on-chain. This is quite revolutionary because this is the first step, but you can imagine how this technology or this partnership can be used for other on-chain payments, like payment of gas fees, payment for smart contracts, etc., etc. So this is a use case that illustrates that capability. So, the way it works is, between us and Chainlink, Mastercard brings the off-chain payment rail for the transaction. And this comes with all the security and safety and convenience that people are used to when using a MasterCard and we have 3.5 billion cards, 3.5 billion cards are now enabled to participate in the economy very easily. What Chainlink brings is their experience for on chain management and the security and the safety that they bring. So when the payment lag happens, Chainlink orchestrates and makes sure that the asset is also transferred Onchain with security. So this is really emerging between an off-chain payment rail and an on-chain asset transfer that between our two companies we have enabled. And what they say, if you want to go fast, go alone, if you want to go far, go together.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a Permissionless stage discussion in which identified Mastercard and Chainlink representatives describe a partnership connecting card payments with on-chain asset transfers. The speakers discuss crypto purchases and claim security, convenience, and broad card availability, but the described discussion does not ask viewers to send money or provide credentials, or invite them into a promised-return scheme. The partnership claims are not described as externally verified, and no completed transaction is shown.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content explains an operational payment and asset-transfer use case, including the described roles of an off-chain payment rail and on-chain coordination.
